term: frame conditions for conceived necessary denial
definition: The reflexive route requires self-access at every world; the alternative route requires transitivity (wRv and vRz imply wRz) and a successor for every world accessible from the selected root. The latter is root-relative successor-seriality, not a globally assumed S5 or D frame. These are sufficient routes for the stated conflict, not a complete characterization of every frame validating it.
note: Issue #268 accessibility-scope comparison, not Hume attribution.
